final: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING AVG(amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS o FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount FROM ev, overall WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.o), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS m FROM kept) SELECT kept.link_to_event, kept.avg_amount, kept.avg_amount - overall.o AS above_overall, kept.avg_amount - km.m AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept, overall, km ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10
